summary: Prototype round 1 at e7b2d2f01 passes. prototype.py is a short native entrypoint that reuses the reviewed Stage 3A Cube and Stage 2 Sample10 adapter unchanged (smoke-report code_sha256 for cube.py, adapter.py, gpu_accept.py, runtime.sh and jungfrau_calibration.py equal the Stage 3A and Stage 2 commit-provenance digests). Wiring is sound: run.sbatch requests one A100 and execs the Stage 2 runtime.sh on prototype.py; the import order (cube first, which inserts the Stage 2 directory on sys.path) resolves gpu_accept/fixture; preflight verifies fixture digests and binds generation.json to the accepted Stage 2 pilot entry; frozen constants are injected only via a constructor-scoped RunSerial._setup_run_calibconst patch, identical to the accepted acceptance harness. Processing is one process, two persistent streams, batch size 7, Cube(max_streams=2), ordinal%29 over 30 bins. Checks match the agreed acceptance: ordered timestamps against the schedule, zero sim10.errors per event (the only published per-event payload), exact bincount, finite sums, empty bin 29, finish only after full iteration, close in finally on success and abort, with report.json written in the outer finally and cleanup errors recorded. Smoke evidence is internally consistent: 1,000 events, banks 501/499, counts 14x35 + 15x34 + 0 = 1,000, export_count 1, cube (30,32,512,1024) float64 whose 4,026,531,968-byte cube.npy and 368-byte counts.npy sizes match evidence.json, runtime psana module hashes equal Stage 2/3A, KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE ON, job 43527071 on sdfampere002. README numbers (501/499, counts, pool peak 6,064,654,848, 18.79 s, 4.03 GB banks) match smoke-report.json, and README/proposal make no 35 kHz, MPI, GDS, multi-step, managed-lifecycle, pixelwise-revalidation or large-dataset claims; the proposal records the November 6 sequencing correction. Three low non-blocking findings: F-008 carried forward (third-stream rejection test still deferred; this entrypoint fixes two streams), F-009 (prototype evidence lacks an explicit implementation-commit/per-file hash binding and itemized readback checks), F-010 (proposal status line is stale).

findings.evidence: The runtime guard at cube.py:99-100 ('More execution streams than explicitly budgeted') remains untested. The prototype fixes n_gpu_streams=2 and Cube(max_streams=2) (prototype.py:58-62), so it cannot reach this path and does not broaden supported stream settings. Stage 3A status.json lists F-008 as deferred nonblocking.
findings.requested_change: Carry forward unchanged: before any configuration with more than two execution streams, add a controlled assertion that a third distinct stream passed to add() raises RuntimeError and leaves the two existing banks and self.seen unchanged. Not required for this prototype.

findings.evidence: evidence.json records only booleans ('independent_saved_array_readback': true, 'all_recorded_code_hashes_match': true) and artifact digests.
